facts.claim: `UntaggedFollowupMode.NEVER` is the floor an unset/unrecognized `SlackSettings.untagged_followup_mode` resolves to in the pre-dispatch webhook gate (`products/slack_app/backend/api.py:_untagged_followups_switched_off`), but inside the Temporal workflow's `ask`-mode activity (`posthog/temporal/ai/slack_app/activities/messaging.py:request_untagged_followup_confirmation_activity`) an unset preference must resolve to `ASK` so the person gets prompted instead of being silently dropped. The repo needs two resolver functions in `products/slack_app/backend/services/slack_settings.py`: `saved_untagged_followup_mode` (returns `None` when unset, used to render the App Home picker without a false initial selection) and `resolve_untagged_followup_mode` (never returns `None`, used by the gates with different unset-floors: `NEVER` with no `slack_user_id` at all, `ASK` otherwise).
facts.evidence: "NULL means the user has never picked, so an untagged reply prompts them." (products/slack_app/backend/models.py comment, post-change) vs. the old resolver comment "An absent row... resolve to `NEVER`: the feature is opt-in" (pre-change, superseded).

facts.claim: The thread follow-up preference is keyed per-(Slack workspace, Slack *reply author*), not per-thread-creator. `resolve_untagged_followup_mode(integration, slack_user_id)` must be called with the id of whoever just replied — `event.get("user")` in the webhook gate, `context.get("slack_user_id")` in the revoke-recheck, the activity's own `slack_user_id` param in the Temporal activity — never with `mapping.mentioning_slack_user_id` (the original thread starter). Passing the thread creator's id here was a bug fixed across three call sites in this area.
facts.evidence: Diff: `resolve_untagged_followup_mode(integration, mapping.mentioning_slack_user_id)` → `resolve_untagged_followup_mode(integration, event.get("user"))` in `_untagged_followups_switched_off`; same substitution in `_untagged_followups_revoked_since_prompt` and in `request_untagged_followup_confirmation_activity`.

facts.claim: The untagged-followup Slack prompt (`products/slack_app/backend/api.py:_post_untagged_followup_prompt`, buttons handled by `_handle_untagged_followup_run`/`_handle_untagged_followup_dismiss`) and the App Home picker (`_untagged_followups_section_blocks` in `products/slack_app/backend/services/slack_app_home.py`, action `ACTION_SET_UNTAGGED_FOLLOWUP_MODE`) both write to the same `SlackSettings.untagged_followup_mode` column keyed on `(slack_workspace_id, slack_user_id)`. A change adding a way to save a default from the prompt (new action ids `UNTAGGED_FOLLOWUP_ACTION_RUN_ALWAYS`/`..._DISMISS_ALWAYS`, `save_default` kwarg) must write the same `UntaggedFollowupMode` enum value the Home tab picker reads, or the two surfaces disagree about the stored preference.
facts.evidence: `SlackSettings.objects.update_or_create(slack_workspace_id=..., slack_user_id=..., defaults={"untagged_followup_mode": UntaggedFollowupMode.AUTO/NEVER})` appears both in `_apply_untagged_followup_mode_pick` (Home tab) and in the new `_handle_untagged_followup_run`/`_handle_untagged_followup_dismiss` save_default branches.
